questions.markdown:
A living room is equipped with the following electrical loads, all connected in parallel to a 230 V, 50 Hz, single-phase AC supply.

- Ceiling fan: 80 W, 0.65 lagging
- Fluorescent lamp: 40 W, 0.7 lagging
- LED lamp: 30 W, 0.95 lagging

Determine the capacitance required to be connected in parallel to achieve unity power factor for the room.

A 3-phase 4-wire, 415 V, ABC system has a star connected load with impedances $Z_A = 6 \angle 0^{\circ}\ \Omega$, $Z_B = 6 \angle 30^{\circ}\ \Omega$ and $Z_C = 5 \angle 45^{\circ}\ \Omega$. Taking the voltage $V_{AB}$ as reference phasor, determine line and neutral currents. Also calculate the real power consumed by the load.

A ring forming a magnetic circuit is made from two materials. One part is mild steel (relative permeability = 2000) of mean length 25 cm and cross-sectional area 4 cm$^2$, and the remainder is cast iron (relative permeability = 1350) of mean length 20 cm and cross-sectional area 7.5 cm$^2$.

Determine the total reluctance of the circuit. Calculate the MMF required to create a flux density of 0.75 Tesla in the steel part of the magnetic circuit.
List any three transformer classifications? Elaborate.
Discuss how the equipment and neutral grounding ensures electrical safety.
List any three renewable power generation sources outlining their salient features.
Compare a Linear Power Supply and a Switched Mode Power Supply (SMPS).
Explain the operation of single-phase half-wave and full-wave rectifiers with the help of circuit diagrams and waveforms.
Describe the general configuration of an Electric Vehicle (EV) system.
